g.text: Nutrition totals and excess warnings: selected relationships
+view(mealsByDay: List<List<MealSummary>>, dayNumber: int, targets: NutritionTargets): String
The supplier interfaces are two bindings of java.util.function.Supplier, not new Java interfaces.
Default parser lambdas capture shared active-plan state; caller-supplied sources can behave differently.
MealPlanViewer calculates totals from MealSummary input; it does not call DayPlan's combined-totals API.
Optional targets are null when omitted. request is an Optional; its contained request is modeled here.
Records are immutable values. Selected methods are abbreviated; unrelated references and most getters are omitted.
